notes.title: [DEMO UPDATE] Language Settings Fix
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

We’ve got great news for you!

[b][Update Details][/b]
[olist]
[*] You can now properly switch languages in the settings within the demo.
[/olist]
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused in the demo.

Thank you for your continued love for Love Delivery!

notes.title: [Update] V2.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

V2.0.7 is now live!

In this update, we've made the following changes:

[b][Update Details][/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed issues with trademarks, copyrights, and other elements that could potentially infringe upon third-party rights.
[olist]
[*] Some images have been updated.
[*] Some sounds have been updated.
[*] Some text has been modified.
[*] Improved certain voice lines.
The full name of "Kwon Latte" has now been recorded and implemented.
Special thanks to voice actors Lee Myung-ho and Kim Hee-seung for their help in recording!
[/olist]
[*] Steam achievements "Honestly, getting money from mom is better" and "If you can't enjoy it, avoid it" will now unlock properly even if a save file already exists.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game wouldn't save if the computer's date and time format wasn't set to 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
[/olist]


We appreciate everyone who reported these issues.

Thank you for your continued love for Love Delivery!

notes.title: [NEWS] Love Delivery is Getting an Historical Discount!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592928/b8a61b924fce6028fb093eb98ea8267cf1eae0f7.png[/img]

Hey Riders,

Great news! [b][u]Love Delivery is offering a historical discount of 35% for the next 7 days[/u][/b]! This is your chance to dive into the world of love at an unbeatable price.

But that’s not all—grab the "Love in Login & Love Delivery" bundle, and you’ll enjoy an extra 10% off! "Love in Login" is another enchanting tale featuring my dear friend Dahye, and trust me, it’s a story you won’t want to miss.

Don’t miss out on this amazing opportunity to experience these heartwarming stories.

See you in the game!

notes.title: [FIX] Cloud Saving issue is now fixed!
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

We want to address an issue some of you have been experiencing with cloud saving feature.
We identified the problem and we’re happy to inform you that this issue has been resolved.

We sincerely apologize to anyone who lost their save files without a backup. We understand how frustrating this can be, and we appreciate your patience as we worked to fix the problem.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: [Update] V2.0.5 is now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

V2.0.5 is now live!
In this update, we fixed the following issues.

[olist]
[*] Fixed a number of controller related issues
[*] Fixed an issue where players could not enter custom names.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Stove warning was displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the language would switch to English after restarting when set to Korean.
[/olist]

Thank you to everyone who reported these issues.

We appreciate your continued love for Love Delivery!

notes.title: [FIX] V2.0.3 Update (Achievement Issue Fixed)
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

There was an issue with Achievement in the latest build, and it is now fixed!

Thank Hadaz for the swift feedback 👍

If you find any issues along the way, please report it to us. We are more than happy to address it.


Thank you 😊

notes.title: [UPDATE] Love Delivery Global Version is Now Live!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited Love Delivery Global Edition is here!

Thank you so much for waiting so long.

Help us deliver love to even more users!

notes.title: Love Delivery Global Edition Announcement and Demo is now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey Riders,

We are excited to announce that "Love Delivery" is going global and will launch in multiple languages on May 21st! Whether you speak English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese, now we've got you covered.

And guess what? You can try out the demo starting today! Get a sneak peek and start spreading love across the globe right away!

We can't wait to see how you all connect and spread joy around the world!

See you in the game!

notes.title: Our Store Page has a new look!
notes.notes:
Hey riders,

Our store page is completely redesigned and it is now full of vibrancy!

Why now, you might ask. 🤔

You are right! Something is coming up soon. By soon, I mean real soon.

So make sure to add it to your wishlist if you haven't and stay tuned for the upcoming news!

See you soon~
